name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars] at *
  all_goals
    repeat' split
    all_goals try simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] at *
    all_goals grind only

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (h : a.Subset c) (k : b.Subset d) : (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) := by
    grind [List.Subset]
  intro h
  induction h
  all_goals try solve | exact List.Subset.empty | repeat first | assumption | apply app
  case app hn he hnold ih₁ ih₂ =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · simp only; exact fun _ h => h
    · next hf =>
      cases hnold .oldPred
      exfalso; apply hf; rfl
    · exact app ih₁ ih₂

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    have h := UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
    simp [hn k hk'] at h

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext a
  by_contra ha
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f a⟫_ℝ) := Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f a) hf continuous_const
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f a, f a⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr ha))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hs⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) a hp
  let b : ContDiffBump a := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hb : IsTestFunction (b : Y → ℝ) := ⟨b.contDiff, b.hasCompactSupport⟩
  have hz := hg (fun x => b x • f a) (hb.smul_right contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, b x * ⟪f x, f a⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    refine (b.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      b.hasCompactSupport.mul_right ?_ (x := a) ?_
    · intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support (b : Y → ℝ)
      · exact mul_nonneg b.nonneg (le_of_lt (hs (by rwa [ContDiffBump.support_eq] at hx)))
      · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]
    · exact ne_of_gt (mul_pos (b.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)) hp)
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hz

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hg : ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x =
      ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x / 𝓕.ε₀ := by
    have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
      (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
    change ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x = _ at hg
    conv_lhs at hg =>
      rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
        fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
    conv_rhs at hg =>
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
      rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
        fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt]
    simpa only [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, mul_comm, div_eq_mul_inv] using hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  calc
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun s =>
          ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq,
        fderiv_fun_sub
          ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
          (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
        fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
      simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
        (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
        time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)),
        Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd _ _) (hEd _ _)]
      conv_lhs =>
        enter [1, 2, 2, j, 2]
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, hg]
      simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq]
      field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b) using Submodule.span_induction
  · rename_i x hx
    obtain ⟨φs, rfl⟩ := hx
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a) using Submodule.span_induction
    · rename_i x hx
      obtain ⟨φs', rfl⟩ := hx
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp only [map_mul]
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
          simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp
    · rename_i x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add]
    · rename_i c x hx hpx
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · norm_num
  · rename_i x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all only [ mul_add, map_add]
  · rename_i c x hx hpx
    simp_all only [ Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => grind
  case abs => grind
  case tabs => grind
  case sub der _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1 with w | ⟨_, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp der _ ih =>
    cases lc with
    | tapp lc h =>
      right
      rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨_, step⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
        exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc h⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .tapp h step⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v body⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h body⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der.wf.2.1).imp Value.inl (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inl h⟩)
  case inr der _ ih =>
    exact (ih rfl der.wf.2.1).imp Value.inr (fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inr h⟩)
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨_, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨_, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v <;> subst h <;> cases v
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inl ‹_› b c⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inr ‹_› b c⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b c⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h k
  induction h generalizing c
  case refl => exact ⟨c, k, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb ih jh =>
    cases k
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := ih hc
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := jh hd
      exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    case red_I =>
      cases I_irreducible _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, hx⟩
    case red_S =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases k
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par hc hd =>
      cases I_irreducible _ hc
      exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K =>
    cases k
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hc
      exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_S =>
    cases k
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par hc hd =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hc
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hd) (.par hy hd), .red_S _ _ _⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  constructor <;> intro u ht <;> cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      first | refine (h.follow_fst ht).elim ?_
            | refine (h.follow_snd ht).elim ?_
      rintro v ⟨hv, hb⟩
      exact ⟨v, Tr.choiceL hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    | choiceR ht =>
      exact ⟨u, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    first | refine (h.follow_fst ht).elim ?_
          | refine (h.follow_snd ht).elim ?_
    rintro v ⟨hv, hb⟩
    exact ⟨v, hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i]


    omega

  

  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      refine Set.image_nonempty.mpr ?_

      exact Set.univ_nonempty
    have h_sInf_mem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty


    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id (Eq.symm h_eq)⟩

  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ


    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at *


    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH;
      simp only [mem_filter, ΔH] at hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; use y_of_x
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset :=
        Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx_in_ΔH.2⟩
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad]

      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro y hy
        simpa only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range,
          Fintype.card_fin, Finset.card_univ] using
          (Finset.card_image_le (s := Finset.univ)
            (f := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
              (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := by have := NeZero.pos 𝓡; dsimp; omega) (y := y)))
      _ = _ := by simp only [sum_const, smul_eq_mul, Set.toFinset_card, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g')
    ·
      simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, d_H];
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)

  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i_plus_steps, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    congr 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega

  change 2 * d_H < (d_i : ℕ∞)
  calc
    2 * d_H ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := mul_le_mul_left' h_dist_bridge 2
    _ = ↑((2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps) := by rw [mul_assoc]; rfl
    _ ≤ ↑((d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps) :=
      ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound)
    _ < (d_i : ℕ∞) := ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (by
      rw [h_algebraic_identity]
      omega)

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  set P_i := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) coeffs
  set new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by

      have h : ℓ - ↑i = ℓ - (↑i + 1) + 1 := by omega
      have h2 : 2^(ℓ - i) = 2^(ℓ - (i + 1)) * 2 := by rw [h, pow_succ]
      omega
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1)) (i := 1)
      · omega
      · omega
    ⟩)
  have h_eval (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
      (x := fiberMap k) (y := y).mpr (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])
    rw [h_res]
  have hx₀ := qMap_total_fiber_basis_sum_repr 𝔽q β i (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) y 0
  have hx₁ := qMap_total_fiber_basis_sum_repr 𝔽q β i (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) y 1
  simp only [Fin.isValue] at hx₀ hx₁

  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    simp only [Fin.isValue, x₁, fiberMap, x₀]
    rw [hx₁, hx₀]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finset_sum, SetLike.val_smul]
    have h_index : ℓ + 𝓡 - i = (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + 1)) + 1 := by omega
    rw! (castMode := .all) [h_index]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ] -- (free_term + y_repr) - (free_term + y_repr) = 1
    -- First, simplify the free terms
    simp only [fiber_coeff, eqRec_eq_cast, lt_one_iff, reducePow, Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, mod_succ,
    dite_smul, ite_smul, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_mod]
    have h_cast_0 :
        (cast (Eq.symm h_index ▸ rfl : Fin (ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + 1) + 1) = Fin (ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i)) 0).val =
        0 := by
      rw [←Fin.cast_eq_cast (h := by omega)]
      rw [Fin.cast_val_eq_val (h_eq := by omega)]
      simp only [Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, mod_succ_eq_iff_lt]
      omega
    
    simp only [h_cast_0, ↓reduceDIte]
    have h_getBit_0_of_0 : Nat.getBit (k := 0) (n := 0) = 0 := by
      decide
    have h_getBit_0_of_1 : Nat.getBit (k := 0) (n := 1) = 1 := by
      decide
    simp only [h_getBit_0_of_1, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, h_getBit_0_of_0, zero_add]
    rw! (castMode := .all) [←h_index]
    
    simp only [cast_eq, get_sDomain_basis, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, zero_mod, add_zero]
    rw [normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1 𝔽q β]
    ring_nf
    conv_rhs => rw [←add_zero (a := 1)]
    rw [add_sub_assoc]
    congr 1
    rw [sub_eq_zero]
    apply Finset.sum_congr (h := by rfl)
    simp only [mem_univ, congr_eqRec, Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_eq_zero, one_ne_zero, and_false, ↓reduceDIte,
    add_tsub_cancel_right, Fin.eta, imp_self, implies_true]
  set P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  -- Equation 39 : P^(i)(X) = P₀^(i+1)(q^(i)(X)) + X · P₁^(i+1)(q^(i)(X))
  have h_equation_39_x₀ : P_i.eval x₀.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, h_eval 0, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, x₀, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have h_equation_39_x₁ : P_i.eval x₁.val = P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, h_eval 1, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, x₁, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  set f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩) => P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  set f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  -- Unfold the definition of f_i_plus_1 using the fold function
  
  -- Main calculation following the outline
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    = f_i x₀ * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        f_i x₁ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := rfl
    _ = P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by dsimp only
    _ = (P₀.eval y.val + x₀.val * P₁.eval y.val) * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        (P₀.eval y.val + x₁.val * P₁.eval y.val) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) := by
      rw [h_equation_39_x₀, h_equation_39_x₁]
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, sum_mul, oddRefinement,
    ← sum_add_distrib, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>
      intro u
      contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        -- `ϑ = 1`
        simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
        intro u
        let toAffineLineEval := multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)
        intro hprob_gt
        simp_rw [toAffineLineEval] at hprob_gt
        let prob_eq := prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e)
        -- Convert sampling (r ← (Fin 1 → F)) into sampling (r ← F)
        simp_rw [prob_eq, Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_correlated_agreement := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
        simp only [jointProximityNat₂] at h_correlated_agreement
        have h_u_eq: u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          match rowIdx with
          | 0 => rfl
          | 1 => rfl
        rw [h_u_eq.symm] at h_correlated_agreement
        exact h_correlated_agreement
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro hϑ_gt_0 u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- `ϑ ≥ 2`
        -- set ϑ_sub_1 := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        
        
        -- have hfinϑ : Fin ϑ = Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) := by rfl
        set U₀ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).1
        set U₁ : Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) → Word A ι :=
          (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) u).2
        unfold jointProximityNat
        simp only
        -- intro hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        have h_finsnoc_eq_r: ∀ r: Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) → F,
          Fin.snoc (fun (i : Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) ↦ r i.castSucc)
            (r (Fin.last (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) = r := fun r => Fin.snoc_init_self r
        let P : F → (Fin (ϑ_sub_2 + 1) → F) → Prop := fun r_last r_init =>
          Δ₀(multilinearCombine (u:=u) (r:=Fin.snoc r_init r_last), MC) ≤ e
        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
          (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (F := F) (P := P)
        unfold P at hP_split_r_last
        simp_rw [h_finsnoc_eq_r] at hP_split_r_last
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- Now we have two randomness sampling in hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt :
        -- `((ϑ_sub_2 + 1 + 1) * ε) / |𝔽|
          -- < Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[  Δ₀((Fin.snoc r_init r_last)|⨂|u, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (0)
        -- We need to achieve the upperbound for hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt probability by:
        -- i.e. `Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[  Δ₀((Fin.snoc r_init r_last)|⨂|u, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- `= Pr_{ r_last; r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- `= PR_{ r_last }[ r_init; Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]`
        -- Divide into two cases: r_last ∈ R* and r_last ∉ R*
        -- `= Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ∧
          -- Pr_{ r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (1)
        -- `+ Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∉ R* ∧
          -- Pr_{ r_init }[ Δ₀((r_init)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ]` (2)
        -- `(1) = Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ]` (3)
        -- `(2): ∀ r ∉ R*, it's trivial that the probability
          -- ≤ ((ϑ_sub_2 + 1) * ε) / |𝔽|, due to definition of membership of R*` (4)

        -- Combine (0), (3), (4): we have `Pr_{ r_last }[ r_last ∈ R* ] > ε/|𝔽|` (5)

        -- Applying `correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor` to (5), we get
          -- `Δ₀((r_last)|⨂|affineCombine(U₀, U₁, r_last), ↑MC) ≤ ↑e)) ] > ε/|𝔽|` (6)
        -- This is premise for affineProxmityGaps of interleaved code (`h_interleaved_gaps`)
          -- for `m = 2^{ϑ_sub_2 + 1}`, which directly leads to Q.E.D.
        let  ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        
        
        -- Step 1: Apply multilinearCombine recursive form
        -- We need the lemma `multilinearCombine u r = multilinearCombine`
          -- `(affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init` where `r = Fin.snoc r_init r_last`
        have multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine
          (r_init : Fin ϑ_pred → F) (r_last : F) : multilinearCombine u (Fin.snoc r_init r_last) =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
          simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.init_snoc]
          rfl
        -- Rewrite the probability using this identity
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine_snoc_eq_multilinearCombine_affine]
          at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        -- hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt now looks like:
        -- Pr_{ r_last ← $ᵖ F; r_init ← $ᵖ (Fin ϑ_pred → F) }[ Δ₀(multilinearCombine
            -- (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init, ↑MC) ≤ ↑e ] > ↑(↑ϑ * ↑ε) / q
        -- Step 2 & 3: Define R* and apply Law of Total Probability
        let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=ϑ_pred) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
        -- Step 5: Show Pr[R*] > ε / q
        have h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[ r ∈ R_star_set ]
          > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
          exact prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1) (u := u)
            (e := e) (hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt)
        -- Convert Pr_{}[] to cardinality
        
        -- Step 6: Apply Inductive Hypothesis for r_last ∈ R*
        have h_line_close_to_C_m : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
          intro r_in_Rstar
          -- Use the lemma proven earlier
          apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
            (ih := fun u_prev => ih (by omega) u_prev ) (u := u)
        -- Step 7: Apply Affine Gap of Interleaved Code C^(m = 2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1))
        have h_C_m_gap := h_interleaved_gaps (2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1)) (Nat.one_le_two_pow)
        -- Need the hypothesis Pr[...] > ε/q for h_C_m_gap
        have h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q :
          Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[
            Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
              (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (r := r),
              ((MC ^⋈ (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1)))))) ≤ e
          ] > (↑ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
            -- This is implied by h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q becuz R* is a subset of the success set
            apply lt_of_le_of_lt' _ h_prob_Rstar_gt_eps_div_q
            apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
            intro r hr
            exact h_line_close_to_C_m ⟨r, hr⟩
        -- Apply the gap property of C^m
        have h_final_gap : jointProximityNat₂
          (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
          (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁)) (e := e)
          (C := (MC ^⋈ (Fin (2^(ϑ_sub_2 + 1))))) := by
          apply h_C_m_gap (u₀ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₀))
            (u₁ := ⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (ϑ_sub_2 + 1))) ι from U₁))
            (h_prob_line_gt_eps_div_q)
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        exact h_final_gap

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  let f (n : ℕ) (k : Fin 4) : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u (n + k), hb _⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite f
  have collision : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hab with h | h
    · exact ⟨a, b, h, he⟩
    · exact ⟨b, a, h, he.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := collision
  have h : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun he ⟨m, hm⟩)
      · have step (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (hp : 0 < k) :
            u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by
          simpa only [Nat.add_sub_assoc hk] using ih (m - k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1,
          step 1 (by omega) (by omega), step 2 (by omega) (by omega),
          step 3 (by omega) (by omega), step 4 (by omega) (by omega)]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have he := (h (n - i)).symm
  convert he using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ A : Set S, Aᶜ ∈ P ↔ A ∉ P := by
    grind
  have he : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp only [compl_compl, Finset.mem_compl, hc, not_not, implies_true, imp_self]
  have hn := Finset.card_add_card_compl P
  have hp := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
  have hw : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hp]
  simp only [Fintype.card_set] at hn
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have step (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation d e) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10^i.1 := by
    have hi := ((hrelation d e).mp h).2 i
    convert hi using 1
    have hs : (∑ j : Fin 9, if j = i then (e j - d j) * (10 : ℤ)^j.1 else 0) =
        (e i - d i) * 10^i.1 := by simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← hs]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    dsimp only
    split_ifs <;> ring
  intro d e f h i
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => step d e h.1 j)
  have he : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hs
    have hd := congrFun hdigits_to_num d
    have he := congrFun hdigits_to_num e
    rw [← hd, ← he] at hs
    omega
  have hh := dvd_sub (dvd_add (step d e h.1 i) (step e f h.2 i)) he
  have hm : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * (10 : ℤ)^i.1 := by
    convert dvd_neg.mpr hh using 1 <;> ring
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  exact hc.pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hm
